items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 4:22 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Councillor P. Singh - Strategic Land Acquisitions Review (Land Acquisition - Section 239 (c))
notes: Councillor P. Singh declared a conflict with regards to Strategic Land Acquisitions Review (Land Acquisition - Section 239 (c)) on the in-camera meeting agenda this date, as he has family that owns property within the vicinity, and he did not participate in any voting or discussion on the matter.

items.title: Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Special Council meeting recessed at 4:27 p.m. and reconvened at 5:59 p.m., chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic with all members present. Councillor M. Johnston participated electronically.

items.title: City owned land - Solicitor-Client Advice (Solicitor / client privilege - Section 239 (2) (f))
Communications Response - Emergency Services (Labour Relations and Personal matters, identifiable individuals Section 239 (2) (b) and (d))
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for February 24. 2025.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 6:15 p.m.

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider two solicitor and client matters, one labour relations and personal matter/identifiable individual matter and one land acquistion matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (b) (c) and (f) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
motions.text_html: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider two solicitor and client matters, one labour relations and personal matter/identifiable individual matter and one land acquistion matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (b) (c) and (f) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."

motions.item_title: City owned land - Solicitor-Client Advice (Solicitor / client privilege - Section 239 (2) (f))
motions.text: "That the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) be directed to approve and execute a new, non-binding MOU with the Regional Municipality of Waterloo for the operation of the Building located at 104 Stirling Avenue South in accordance with the in-camera report COR-2025-087, to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor."
